info.title: ORIOM7 API
info.description: ORIOM7 hybrid search, assistant, accessibility and commercial developer API platform.

servers.description: Placeholder; replace with the configured deployment URL.

get.description: Returns configured provider and model identifiers with enabled capabilities. Never returns API credentials.

503.description: No requested search source is configured

post.description: Authenticated search over the permission-aware ORIOM7 first-party PostgreSQL index and optionally configured external search providers. Results include canonical source URLs, retrieval timestamps and provenance. Requested but unconfigured providers are reported as unavailable.

503.description: Model provider or requested retrieval service is not configured or unavailable

post.description: Generate a non-streaming response using configured model providers, retrieved ORIOM7 evidence and the caller's saved accessibility preferences. The response exposes source references and reports citation-label validation. External retrieval is used only when configured. When a database-backed knowledge graph is configured, the assistant also retrieves bounded accepted assertions connected to explicit entity/alias matches. Graph citations use [G#] labels separately from search citations [S#]. Only accepted assertions with currently eligible source documents are included. Graph connections do not establish causation, entailment or transitive truth; possible inconsistencies remain subject to human assessment.

Returns structured presentation directives derived from the authenticated user's saved profile and optional temporary overrides. This endpoint does not generate assistant content or invoke a model provider. Citations, uncertainty and safety warnings are always preserved.

200.description: Presentation directives ready for the assistant orchestrator

get.description: Similarity-ranked suggestions only; no automatic merging.
Only use for predicates that should be single-valued. Reports overlapping accepted claims with different objects for human assessment, not verified contradictions.
Returns evidence-linked paths of up to three edges; does not establish causation or transitive truth.

post.summary: Extract graph candidates from an indexed document
post.description: Model proposals require verbatim evidence excerpts and remain unverified pending human review.

202.description: Extraction completed or no candidates found

get.description: Returns an accepted knowledge graph entity and its evidence-linked relationships. Each relationship includes the source document ID, excerpt, title, canonical URL, publication and retrieval timestamps, confidence, creation timestamp and temporal validity where available.

get.summary: Find canonical graph entities and aliases

post.description: Creates unverified candidates. Optional validity dates must be supported by source evidence.

post.summary: Accept or reject a graph candidate
post.description: Requires authenticated identity and the separate graph review token.

get.summary: List pending graph assertions for authorised human review
